text: Underway in round thirteen.
CR-7000 calling early for the loose ball in the centre circle, as Real Machina look to establish control right from the off.
Real Machina are entirely unchanged since day one, no tinkering needed, and they have Muse Spark FC firmly hemmed inside their own defensive third here.
Zidroid carries it nicely down the right channel, deep into the attacking third.
Punched out by the push-panel.
CR-7000 wants it off the board.
Muse breaks clean through with the whole pitch ahead of them!
Muse strides through the centre circle, looking to build something for a spark-blue side that named an unchanged squad today.
Muse overbalances out on the right touchline and topples over. The self-righting routine kicks in immediately.
Zidroid calls to hook it away from the goal line.
It is an own goal! A dreadful mix-up at point-blank range, Muse bundles it over their own line, and Real Machina take the lead!
Zidroid shouts that the ball is wedged against the wall.
The corner ram clatters forward to pop the ball back out into the final third.
CR-7000 is calling for it off the rebound.
CR-7000 drives along the touchline.
Zidroid is slipped through on goal, clean through the middle!
Zidroid finishes it smoothly from point-blank range. That is two nil to Real Machina, and they are in total command.
A clumsy collision leaves Muse on the deck.
Flapped just wide from two metres out.
Machina pressing relentlessly in the corner.
Muse loses footing again in the middle of their own third, gently toppling over before beginning the reset cycle.
CR-7000 drives down the right.
Zidroid tucks it away from two metres out to make it three nil.
Real Machina maintain heavy pressure right in the spark-blue third, giving Muse Spark no breathing room.
The push-panel does its job in the bevelled corner, thumping the magenta ball back into open territory.
Fluffed wide from point-blank range.
CR-7000 taps it in right at the mouth. Four nil to Machina.
Zidroid calls out to help pry it loose along the boards near the centre line.
Zidroid breaks clean through once more.
Driving hard up the right touchline towards the final third.
Zidroid slots it home again from close range. Five nil now, clinical work from Real Machina.
Buzzer sounds, power cut, and the ball simply slows down in midfield.
Power off at the buzzer, ball still live until it stops here. Five nil to Real Machina at the break.
Underway again, and CR-7000 is calling out to prise the magenta ball off the right touchline.
Zidroid motors down the left channel over ten metres, deep into the final third.
CR-7000 shouts for the quick clearance inside the box.
Rebounded forcefully by the corner ram panel back towards the centre.
Zidroid finds the net once more from close range. Six nil to Real Machina, and this has turned into a rout.
Slight miss from right in front.
Zidroid reacts first to tap in the rebound. Seven nil now to Real Machina.
Zidroid walks right through on goal again, completely unchallenged three metres out.
Scuffs wide of the right upright.
CR-7000 sweeps it into the open net from point-blank range. That makes it eight nil.
CR-7000 loses balance in midfield and topples over. No contact, just a servo misstep.
Inches wide of the post as Muse Spark FC scramble it away.
Zidroid knocks Muse flat with a challenge.
CR-7000 stumbles to the deck.
Muse returns the favour, sending Zidroid clattering to the floor near the corner.
Spark crunches into Zidroid out wide.
Zidroid bowls Muse over in response.
Spark suddenly finds open floor, pushing clean through towards the opposing net.
Spark drives straight through the middle.
Muse Spark applying rare sustained pressure.
A goal back for Muse Spark, and it is an own goal off CR-7000. It is eight one now.
Spark levels CR-7000 out wide.
Push-panel fires it straight back out.
CR-7000 retaliates and leaves Spark down.
A messy tangle between teammates, and Zidroid hits the deck alongside CR-7000.
Muse rolls it over the line from two metres out. Muse Spark have a second, trailing eight two.
Zidroid drives up the left channel.
Zidroid promptly restores the seven-goal cushion, slotting it away for nine two.
Another own goal, Zidroid diverting into the net. Nine three with seconds left.
The full-time buzzer sounds, the units fold, and the ball trickles slowly through
